policy: No agent is shown to users until verificationStatus is 'verified'. Verification requires: (1) confirmed business registration in operating country, (2) licence number where applicable, (3) reference check, (4) signed commercial agreement. Agents with verificationStatus 'pending' or 'suspended' are never surfaced in the UI.

agents._note: Copy this object, remove _template and _note, fill all fields, set verificationStatus to verified when due diligence is complete.
